description: $0.007 — Call this before placing an order to decide whether to execute now or wait — scores the current window 0-100 from trading session, regime, Fear & Greed and volatility, and returns EXECUTE_NOW / GOOD_WINDOW / WAIT_15MIN / WAIT_SESSION with a recommended order type and the next favourable window. Param: coin (default BTC).
name: execution_window_optimizer
